title: MBESO2D: An open MATLAB implementation of stress-state-based multi-material BESO
description: MBESO2D is an open MATLAB implementation of stress-state-based multi-material bi-directional evolutionary structural optimization for two-dimensional continua. It supports retained-solid regions, line loads, and self-weight. The repository includes compact solvers, explanatory comments, an equation-to-code map, numerical records, scripts for reproducing manuscript figures and tables, and verification experiments for sensitivity and material-assignment histories. The documentation defines the scope and limitations of the numerical comparisons. The manuscript reproduction source dated 15 November 2026 (commit 7027a5a82895f32209b2a1e212bb38d7ed5601e2) is archived as Version 1.0.0 at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24244523. The initial release remains available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22109432.
